steps.en: The revival job runs by itself every night
steps.id: Job revival jalan sendiri tiap malam

steps.en: Suspensions that reached their end date are picked up
steps.id: Suspend yang sudah sampai tanggal berakhir diambil

steps.en: The ended suspension is closed off first
A new suspension with the same classified code is applied
steps.id: Suspend baru dengan kode classified yang sama dipasang

steps.en: The new suspension lasts as long as the previous one
steps.id: Suspend baru berlangsung selama suspend sebelumnya
steps.why_en: The length is read from a setting again, not copied, and the setting value is not visible in code.
steps.why_id: Lamanya dibaca ulang dari pengaturan, bukan disalin dari yang lama, dan nilai pengaturan tidak terlihat di code.

steps.en: The notice never sits unsuspended between two suspensions
steps.id: Notice tidak pernah tanpa suspend di antara dua suspend
steps.why_en: If re-applying fails the notice stays unsuspended until the next run; the failure is only logged.
steps.why_id: Kalau pemasangan ulang gagal, notice tanpa suspend sampai run berikutnya; kegagalan hanya dicatat.
